title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Inequalities
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: The number of integers $n$ that satisfy the inequalities $|n - 60| < |n - 100| < |n - 20|$ is
questions.explain:
Break the compound inequality into two parts:
1) $|n - 100| < |n - 20|$ means the distance of $n$ to 100 is less than its distance to 20. Thus, $n$ must be closer to 100 than to 20 $\implies n > 60$.
2) $|n - 60| < |n - 100|$ means the distance of $n$ to 60 is less than its distance to 100. Thus, $n$ must be closer to 60 than to 100 $\implies n < 80$.
Combining these constraints, we get $60 < n < 80$.
The integer values for $n$ range from 61 to 79 inclusive.
The number of integers is $79 - 61 + 1 = 19$.
